archetypes.name: launcher-parity
archetypes.rationale: Python review launcher must preserve the retired shell contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new agent launch-review implementation against the documented Codex and Cursor launcher contracts. Focus on sidecar ordering, retry bounds, auth and model preflight exits, token cap behavior, and dirty-tree semantics. Look for parity regressions hidden by the pytest stubs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retry-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Collector retry metadata now fails closed on retired launcher paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the caller cutover and collect-agent-results retry path. Check that canonical OUTER_LAUNCHER metadata replays through the Python verb, retired shell metadata cannot execute, and voting, scout, waterfall, and docs all reference the same runtime surface. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
